title: Quant
description: Markets across venues per asset, the engines' signals and their trading.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, venue, avg((toFloat64(bid_price) + toFloat64(ask_price)) / 2) AS mid FROM md.quote WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) = '${asset}') GROUP BY time, venue ORDER BY time

panels.title: Each venue's mid against the venues' average (bps): $asset

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, venue, (mid - avg(mid) OVER (PARTITION BY time)) / avg(mid) OVER (PARTITION BY time) * 10000 AS bps FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, venue, avg((toFloat64(bid_price) + toFloat64(ask_price)) / 2) AS mid FROM md.quote WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) = '${asset}') GROUP BY time, venue) ORDER BY time

panels.description: Positive: the venue quotes above the others. Linear USDT, inverse USD and USDC contracts differ by their quote currency's basis.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg((toFloat64(ask_price) - toFloat64(bid_price)) / (toFloat64(ask_price) + toFloat64(bid_price))) * 20000 AS bps FROM md.quote WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top-10 book imbalance (bid − ask) / (bid + ask)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg((arraySum(bids.size) - arraySum(asks.size)) / greatest(arraySum(bids.size) + arraySum(asks.size), 1e-12)) AS imbalance FROM md.book_snapshot WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, instrument ORDER BY time

panels.description: +1: all the visible depth is bids. Sizes are each venue's own units (contracts on Deribit and OKX).

panels.title: Traded notional share by venue (selected assets)

targets.rawSql: SELECT venue, round(sum(toFloat64(price) * toFloat64(size))) AS notional FROM md.trade WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY venue ORDER BY notional DESC

panels.description: Price × size in each venue's units: comparable for linear contracts; inverse contracts (Deribit) count USD sizes × price.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, venue, count() / $__interval_s AS trades FROM md.trade WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, venue ORDER BY time

panels.title: Funding rate now, by asset and venue (% per interval)

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) AS asset, venue, round(argMax(toFloat64(rate), f.ts_event) * 100, 5) AS rate_pct, argMax(interval_minutes, f.ts_event) AS interval_minutes, max(f.ts_event) AS updated FROM md.funding_rate AS f INNER JOIN md.instrument_spec AS s USING (symbol, venue) GROUP BY asset, venue ORDER BY asset, venue

SELECT m.time AS time, m.instrument AS instrument, (m.mark - i.idx) / i.idx * 10000 AS basis_bps FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(toFloat64(price)) AS mark FROM md.mark_price WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, instrument) AS m INNER JOIN (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts_event) AS time, concat(symbol, '.', venue) AS instrument, avg(toFloat64(price)) AS idx FROM md.index_price WHERE $__timeFilter(ts_event) AND (symbol, venue) IN (SELECT symbol, venue FROM md.instrument_spec WHERE if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) IN (${asset:singlequote})) GROUP BY time, instrument) AS i USING (time, instrument) ORDER BY time
SELECT ts AS time, mid, ema5m, ema30m, ema1h FROM engine.ema WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND app = 'engine-an1' AND asset = '${asset}' ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'engine-', ''), ' ', labels['asset']) AS series, avg(value) AS position FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'position' AND labels['asset'] IN (${asset:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'engine-', ''), ' ', labels['asset']) AS series, avg(value) AS pnl FROM metrics.metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'pnl' AND labels['asset'] IN (${asset:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Orders and fills per minute by engine

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, series, n FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, concat(app, ' orders') AS series, count() AS n FROM orders.new_order WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, series UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, concat(replaceOne(app, 'exch-sim-', 'engine-'), ' fills') AS series, count() AS n FROM orders.execution_report WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND status = 'Filled' GROUP BY time, series) ORDER BY time

list.query: SELECT DISTINCT if(base = 'XBT', 'BTC', base) FROM md.instrument_spec ORDER BY 1
